First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @cruisedetroit the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cruise: Detroit group ride

Queers on bikes. A casual, monthly-ish group ride in and around Detroit, with allies welcome. Routes and meet points change; follow the Instagram for the next one.
